V primeru skupne ponudbe lahko pogoj partnerji izpolnijo skupaj. V primeru, da ponudnik nastopa s podizvajalci, lahko pogoj ponudnik in podizvajalci dokazujejo skupno. DOKAZILO: - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz prve alineje prvega odstavka te točke: Izpolnjen obrazec P- 10 Referenca ponudnika. Referenca mora biti potrjena s strani naročnika referenčnega posla s podpisom. V kolikor se referenca nanaša na naročnika (Ministrstvo za zunanje in evropske zadeve), ponudnik izpolni vse podatke, vendar podpis reference s strani naročnika ni potreben. - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz druge alineje prvega odstavka te točke: ustrezna navedba v točki 3 obrazca P-2 Prijava in dokazila o izkušnjah ter sodelovanju strokovnjaka (npr. pogodba o zaposlitvi). 9.4.2 Vsi kadri ponudnika, ki bodo opravljali dela predmetnega javnega naročila, bodo varnostno preverjeni s strani naročnika v skladu z 16a. členom Zakona o zunanjih zadevah (Uradni list RS št. 113/03– uradno prečiščeno besedilo, s spremembami in dopolnitvami, v nadaljevanju ZZZ-1). This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations. STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi
